itemUsage.en: The archaeologist Pepe digs into the past buried by sand.
itemUsage.zh: 考古学家佩佩，发掘那些被黄沙掩埋的过往。

itemDesc.en: She seeks the pieces left behind by history, and leaves the dreams of the greedy in pieces.
itemDesc.zh: 她喜欢拼凑历史遗留下的碎片，也喜欢击碎一些贪婪者的“梦想”。

description.en:

description.en:
Operator Pepe has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for close-quarters combat and inflicting Physical damage over a wide area.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Guard Operator during field operations to exercise Earthshaker responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

description.en:
Pepe folds her arms. The bottom of the heavy curtains shifts ever so slightly before settling back down again.
'Found you. You lose.'
With a sigh, she lifts up the curtains. A cloudbeast pokes its head out from the swathes of fabric, then jumps down onto her foot before scampering off.
'That wasn't me. You lose.'
The voice comes from the cabinet in the corner. It opens, and a boy walks out.
'You shouldn't hide in Mother's room. If Father finds out, he'll get mad.'
'No he won't. He'll just look at me, sigh, and say nothing. Not to mention that he sneaks in himself sometimes.'
'I guess we really are family... Alright, you win. What do you want?'
The boy thinks in silence, fiddling with his fingers, before giving his reply—
'You have Mother's perfume, right?'
'Don't even think about it. She left it to me.'
'There are two bottles, at least give me one of them.'
'It's a set, I can't just split them up.'
'...Fine. She never carried me, so I have no idea what she smells like... I was just curious is all.'
Upon seeing the face so very much like her mother's frown in melancholy, Pepe sinks into a silent reminiscence of her own.
She didn't want to tell her brother that, after so many years, the perfume had long since evaporated, leaving two empty bottles in her drawer.
She also did not want to tell him that she, too, does not remember what their mother smelled like. Time has seen the scent evaporate from her memories as well.
If there was one thing that could remind her of those wondrous bygone days, it was the face she sees in front of her.
'Mother... did give me a pair of storm glasses too. I can give you one, if you'd like?'
'Hmm... But if the weather changes, the maid can tell me.'
'Way to read the room. If you don't want it, fine, have it your way.'
The boy pouts, but just as Pepe thinks he's about to grumble, he breaks out into a gleaming smile, stepping forward to give her a big kiss on the cheek.
'You're the best, Sis.'
Rain begins to pour down outside the window as the solution within the bottle clouds up and tiny star-like crystals form.
Pepe folds her arms as a maid stands quietly by her side and a cloudbeast rubs itself against her feet.
'He didn't take this storm glass with him?'
For a moment, the maid is silent.
'Young Master Senid believes... this storm glass and yours are a pair, and should not be separated.'
Pepe sighs before turning to the maid.
'Then what did he take?'
'Some clothes, a few books, a few pens, and...
'And a portrait of you.'
description.zh:
佩佩抱起双臂，厚重的窗帘垂在窗边，底端的布微不可察地动了下，随即恢复平静。
“你输了……我找到你了。”
叹口气，佩佩径直走上前掀开窗帘，一只云兽探出头来，跳下窗台踩着她的脚离开。
“你输了……我不在那里。”
墙角的柜子里传来动静，柜门打开，一个男孩走了出来。
“你不该躲在母亲的房间，父亲知道了会生气的。”
“才不会，对着我的脸他只会沉默和叹气，更何况有时候他也会偷偷躲到这里来。”
“咱们还真是一家人……你赢了，想要什么？”
男孩沉默地思考，扣了扣手指，然后回答——
“妈妈的香水在你那里吗？”
“想都别想，那是她留给我的。”
“有两瓶，至少分给我一瓶。”
“那可是一对，怎么可能分开来？”
“……好吧，她从没抱过我，我不知道她闻起来是什么样的……我只是有些好奇。”
看见那张酷似母亲的面庞露出惆怅的表情，佩佩陷入回忆与沉默。
她不想告诉弟弟，数年过去，瓶中香水如今早已挥发，只剩下两个空空的香水瓶摆在抽屉里。
她也不想告诉他，自己也记不清母亲闻起来是什么味道了，留在她脑海里的气味也随着岁月挥发干净了。
如果还有什么能提醒她和母亲相依的日子有多美好，就只剩下眼前这张脸了。
“母亲……还给过我一对天气瓶，我分给你一个好不好？”
“嗯……如果天气有变化，侍女会告诉我。”
“别蹬鼻子上脸，不要就算了。”
男孩噘起嘴，就在佩佩以为他又要抱怨些什么时，他却展露出灿烂的笑容，凑上前来在她脸侧落下一个响亮的吻。
“你最好了，姐姐。”
窗外正在下雨，瓶中的溶液朦胧，悬浮着小的星状结晶。
佩佩抱起双臂，侍女安静地站在她的身边，一只云兽在她两脚间蹭来蹭去。
“他走的时候没带上这个天气瓶吗？”
侍女沉默片刻，随后开口。
“塞尼德少爷认为……这和您的天气瓶是一对，不应该分开来。”
佩佩叹口气，看向侍女。
“那他带走什么了？”
“几件衣服、几本书、几支笔，还有……
“还有一幅您的肖像。”
